title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs. [Operator approved 2026-08-17: implement as recommended; slices S1-S5 cut as AGT-2666..2670.] [Curation 2026-08-17: stays current. All five delivery slices AGT-2666, AGT-2667, AGT-2668, AGT-2669 and AGT-2670 are still in lane 3-progress, so nothing is closable yet. The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" are not part of the descriptor vocabulary and made this Dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; they are corrected to decided/testing, which the platform maps to the same decided lifecycle state.]
